title: Time Picker
api:
interface TimePickerProps extends Omit<
  InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>,
  'type' | 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'size' | 'step' | 'min' | 'max'
> {
  value?: string | null
  defaultValue?: string | null
  onValueChange?: (value: string | null) => void
  label?: string
  min?: string
  max?: string
  /** Interval in minutes, from 1 to 60. The step base is min, or midnight. */
  step?: number
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  clearable?: boolean
  error?: string
  loading?: boolean
}

props.name: step
props.description: Interval in minutes, from 1 to 60. The step base is min, or midnight.

notes: Values are HH:mm wall-clock strings or null, not Date instances. step is a minute increment (1–60).
TimePicker does not convert timezones. Store a separate date/timezone when scheduling real events.
